name: Alistair Finch
bio:
Alistair's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by countless hours spent tinkering with go-karts in his youth. He honed his engineering skills at Imperial College London, specializing in aerodynamics, before landing a coveted position at a leading Formula 3 team. There, he quickly ascended the ranks, impressing his superiors with his meticulous approach and keen eye for detail. 

Alistair firmly believes that success on the track stems from a holistic approach, blending cutting-edge technology with a deep understanding of driver needs. He fosters open communication within his team, encouraging collaborative problem-solving and continuous improvement. His pragmatic nature ensures that decisions are always data-driven and focused on achieving tangible results. Alistair's dedication to perfection, while sometimes taxing, has consistently led to significant performance gains for his teams.

 He is known for his unflappable demeanor under pressure, and his ability to quickly diagnose and resolve technical issues. Alistair is now looking for a new challenge, where he can apply his expertise to help a team achieve its full potential.

physical.description: Alistair is of average height, with a lean build and an intense gaze.
